300001.name: Sniper Warfare 1
300001.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

300502.name: Herd Mentality
300502.describe: Uses Light Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.25x</color> DMG. This attack prioritizes Arms.

300503.name: Joint Venture Advantage
300503.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack, grant allies involved in a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> DMG <color=#F74848>+30%</color>.

300504.name: Asset Injection
300504.describe: Designate 1 ally and grant this ally <color=#F74848>1</color> additional use of <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>, effective for <color=#F74848>1</color> time. Can continue the action with the remaining movement.

300505.name: Financing
300505.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack, inflict <buf ID=900045>[DMG Taken UP]</buf> on the target after combat. The effect of this state is based on the number of allies involved in a Link Attack. For each <color=#F74848>1</color> ally involved, increase the effect by <color=#F74848>5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>15%</color>, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

300506.name: Private Investment
300506.describe: Uses Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.2x</color> DMG. Before combat, access <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> mode.

300507.name: Long-term Hold
300507.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack in combat, if the target cannot retaliate, increase the remaining turns of the target's carried debuffs by <color=#F74848>1</color>.

300508.name: ALL IN
300508.describe: Uses Light Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.3x</color> DMG and inflicting <buf ID=900048>[Weight of Hit UP]</buf> immediately. Before combat, access <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> mode. All enable allies to launch <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> against this target. This [Link Attack] does not require allies to possess a specific skill and does not consume any Link times.

300011.name: Sniper Warfare 2

300034.name: Forbidden Zone 2

300035.name: Forbidden Zone 3

300036.name: Forbidden Zone 4
